import sqlite3, json
p="/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp/openwebui-data/webui.db"
c=sqlite3.connect("file:"+p+"?mode=ro",uri=True)
c.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
for k in ("task.model.default","task.model.external","task.model.params"):
    r=c.execute('select value,updated_at from config where "key"=?',(k,)).fetchone()
    print(k,"=",r)
ids=[]
for k in ("task.model.default","task.model.external"):
    r=c.execute('select value from config where "key"=?',(k,)).fetchone()
    if r:
        try: ids.append(json.loads(r[0]))
        except Exception: pass
for i in sorted(set(x for x in ids if isinstance(x,str))):
    r=c.execute('select id,name,base_model_id,is_active,updated_at from model where id=?',(i,)).fetchone()
    print("binding_model",i,"=",r)
c.close()
PY
